title: The first boss.
note: Tuning: the Stag walks 0.7 cells/s and charges x2.5 after 4 straight tiles, so the board is short: the open route lets it charge first, then a few Thornwalls near the Heartwood bend it. Spawned directly (no drift wait).
captions: The first boss: the Hollow Stag.
On a straight line, it charges.
So bend the maze. Every corner breaks the charge.
2% left at the door. Too close.
